name: TwoDoo
description: Tasks & habits — TickTick-style boards, lists, smart lists, quick-add, recurrence, habit tracking. Implemented (v1).

endpoints.name: listBoards
endpoints.description: Full board forest for the caller's active spaces: root boards with nested children, each with lists and rollup open/due-today counts.

endpoints.name: createBoard
endpoints.description: Creates a board in a space, optionally nested under a parent board (same space).

endpoints.name: updateBoard
endpoints.description: Rename / recolor / re-parent (cycle-guarded) / reorder / collapse a board.

endpoints.name: deleteBoard
endpoints.description: Deletes a board with every descendant board, list, task, checklist and tag link.

endpoints.name: createList
endpoints.description: Creates a task list inside a board.

endpoints.name: updateList
endpoints.description: Rename / recolor / move-to-board / reorder a list.

endpoints.name: deleteList
endpoints.description: Deletes a list and all its tasks (hard delete).

endpoints.name: listTasks
endpoints.description: Task query endpoint. One of listId / boardId / smart selects the set; filters compose. `smart` ∈ today|tomorrow|week|month|all|completed (today/week/month include overdue open tasks).

endpoints.name: createTask
endpoints.description: Creates a task. `tagNames` auto-creates missing tags in the task's space (quick-add path); `tagIds` links existing ones. Recurring tasks compute recurrence_next_at from startAt.

endpoints.name: getTask
endpoints.description: One task with tags + checklist.

endpoints.name: updateTask
endpoints.description: Patch any task field; tagIds replaces the tag set.

endpoints.name: deleteTask
endpoints.description: Hard-deletes a task with subtasks, checklist items and tag links. (Soft path = PATCH status=trashed.)

endpoints.name: completeTask
endpoints.description: Toggle completion, TickTick-style: completing a recurring task spawns the next occurrence (shifted dates, fresh unchecked checklist, copied tags) and returns it as `spawned`.

endpoints.name: reorderTasks
endpoints.description: Manual ordering: place a task between two neighbors (fractional position computed server-side); optionally move it to another list.

endpoints.name: addChecklistItem
endpoints.description: Appends a checklist (subtask) item to a task.

endpoints.name: updateChecklistItem
endpoints.description: Edit / toggle / reorder a checklist item.

endpoints.name: deleteChecklistItem
endpoints.description: Removes a checklist item.

endpoints.name: listTags
endpoints.description: All tags across the caller's active spaces.

endpoints.name: createTag
endpoints.description: Creates a tag in a space (name unique per space).

endpoints.name: updateTag
endpoints.description: Rename / recolor a tag.

endpoints.name: deleteTag
endpoints.description: Deletes a tag and its task links.

endpoints.name: getOverview
endpoints.description: Home-page bootstrap: board forest + smart-list counts in one call. Seeds a default board/list when the space is empty (first use).

endpoints.name: listHabits
endpoints.description: Habits with logs (optionally bounded by date range) and computed streaks.

endpoints.name: createHabit
endpoints.description: Creates a habit tracker.

endpoints.name: updateHabit
endpoints.description: Edit a habit (name, schedule, goal, archive…).

endpoints.name: deleteHabit
endpoints.description: Deletes a habit and its logs.

endpoints.name: logHabit
endpoints.description: Check in a habit for a day (delta +1/-1; the day's row is upserted, removed at zero).
